tool.name: Arize Phoenix
tool.description: Source-available AI observability and evaluation platform: OpenTelemetry/OpenInference tracing, evals, prompt iteration and experiments.
strengths: Datasets and experiments to compare app versions
tool.licenseWarning: Phoenix uses the Elastic License 2.0, which is source-available rather than OSI open source. It forbids offering Phoenix to third parties as a hosted or managed service and forbids circumventing license-key features. Internal self-hosting is allowed.
tool.pricing: Phoenix open source is free and self-hosted. The commercial Arize AX has Free ($0), Pro ($50/month) and custom Enterprise tiers.
tool.logoNotes: Fallback: no reviewed logo asset sourced yet.
tool.practitionerNote: A strong local-first option for internal tracing and evals, and OpenInference instrumentation keeps traces portable. The ELv2 license rules out reselling Phoenix as a managed service, and certifications (SOC 2, ISO 27001) belong to Arize's commercial AX platform, not to a self-hosted Phoenix.

dataResidency.detail: Self-hosted on Docker, Kubernetes or any cloud, so the operator controls where trace data lives.

deployment.detail: Self-hosted via Docker or Kubernetes. Managed and self-hosted enterprise options are sold separately as Arize AX.

auditLogging.detail: The Phoenix docs overview does not describe a native audit or access log for user actions.

soc2.detail: Self-hosted software. SOC 2 applies to the operator's infrastructure (Arize's own SOC 2 covers its commercial AX platform).

iso27001.detail: Self-hosted software. ISO 27001 applies to the operator's ISMS (Arize's certification covers the company and AX, not a self-hosted Phoenix).

iso42001.detail: Self-hosted software. ISO 42001 applies to the deploying organisation.

euAiAct.detail: Observability and evaluation tooling, not an AI system placed on the market. Obligations rest with the deployer of the traced system.

licenseRisk.detail: Elastic License 2.0: source-available and not OSI-approved. It bans offering Phoenix as a hosted or managed service and bans circumventing license keys.
